articles.title: GEG Wins Four Accolades at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards; Including “Best Integrated Resort” for the Fourth Consecutive Year and “Best Individual CSR Initiative”
articles.summary: September 16, 2026 – Galaxy Entertainment Group (“GEG”) garnered four awards at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards held in Manila, making it once again the most awarded integrated resort operator in Macau. Galaxy Macau was named “Best Integrated Resort” for the fourth consecutive year and “Best IR Gaming Floor”, Capella at Galaxy Macau was named “Best Hotel in an IR” for the second consecutive year, and the “GEG Sports for Good Community Program” received “Best Individual CSR Initiative”.

articles.title: Four Wynn Restaurants Recognized in the Trip.Gourmet 2027 Global Fine Dining Awards
articles.summary: Macao, September 9, 2026 – Four of Wynn's signature restaurants have been honored at Trip.Gourmet's 10th Anniversary Edition: Global Restaurant Rankings and Fine Dining Awards Ceremony held in Singapore on September 8. Chef Tam's Seasons received the highest honor of "Black Diamond" award, while Mizumi, Wing Lei and Drunken Fish were each honored with the prestigious "Platinum" award.

articles.title: Five SJM Restaurants Are Honoured at Trip.Gourmet’s 10th Anniversary Awards
articles.summary: (Macau, 8 September 2026) Robuchon au Dôme of SJM Resorts, S.A. has retained the Black Diamond rating of Trip.Gourmet’s 2027 Global Restaurant Selection for the fourth consecutive year. Palace Garden and The Eight received Diamond ratings, and Don Alfonso 1890 and Mesa by José Avillez received Platinum.

articles.title: SJM Hosts Fortune Leaders Forums Macau Debut at GLP
articles.summary: (Macau, 9 September 2026) SJM Resorts, S.A. served as host partner and venue supporter of the Fortune Leaders Forum 2026, presented by Fortune and held at Grand Lisboa Palace Resort Macau. More than 250 senior executives, policymakers and investors gathered for the forum’s Macau debut.

articles.title: Three MGM Restaurants Recognized in Trip.Gourmet’s 2027 Global Fine Dining Selection
articles.summary: [September 8, 2026, Macau] Three of MGM’s signature dining restaurants have been listed on the Trip.Gourmet 2027 Global Fine Dining Selection. Aji makes its debut as a Platinum Restaurant, while returning honorees Five Foot Road and Imperial Court have been recognized as Diamond Restaurant and Platinum Restaurant, respectively.

articles.title: Sands China Hosts ‘The Parisian Macao 10th Anniversary Community Fun Day’
articles.rawDate: Sep.6 Sands China Hosts ‘The Parisian Macao 10th Anniversary Community Fun Day’
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 6, 2026) – To celebrate the 10th anniversary of The Parisian Macao, Sands China hosted The Parisian Macao 10th Anniversary Community Fun Day on Sept. 5, welcoming 130 participants, including family members from local social service organisations and Sands Cares Ambassadors. The initiative reflects the Sands Cares spirit of caring for Macao and serving the community.

articles.title: MGM Donates MOP5 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Xizang
articles.summary: [September 4, 2026, Macau] MGM China Holdings Limited announced a donation of MOP5 Million to the Xizang Autonomous Region, with the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macau SAR, to support emergency relief operations and post-disaster recovery efforts in Gyirong County, Xigaze, after a severe mudslide.

articles.title: Sands China Donates MOP 10 Million in Support of Xizang Mudslide Relief Efforts
articles.rawDate: Sep.4 Sands China Donates MOP 10 Million in Support of Xizang Mudslide Relief Efforts
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 4, 2026) – Sands China Ltd. announced that the company will donate MOP 10 million to support relief efforts in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, following a devastating mudslide. The donation will be made with the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Macao SAR.

articles.title: SJM Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction Efforts in Gyirong County
articles.summary: (Macau, 4 September 2026) SJM Resorts, S.A. donated MOP 5 million through the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macao SAR to support emergency rescue operations, resettlement of displaced residents, and post-disaster reconstruction in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet Autonomous Region.

articles.title: Wynn Donates MOP5 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Gyirong, Xizang
articles.summary: Macao, September 4, 2026 – Wynn Macau, Limited announced a donation of MOP5 million to support emergency relief and post-disaster recovery efforts in Gyirong County, Xigaze City, Xizang Autonomous Region, with the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macao SAR.

articles.title: GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation Donate MOP10 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Xizang
articles.summary: September 3, 2026 – Galaxy Entertainment Group (“GEG”) announced that, with the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macau SAR, GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation will jointly donate MOP10 million to support emergency relief and post-disaster recovery efforts in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region.

articles.title: Sands China Receives Two MICE Honours at M&C Asia Stella Awards 2026
articles.rawDate: Sep.3 Sands China Receives Two MICE Honours at M&C Asia Stella Awards 2026
articles.summary: (Macao, September 3, 2026) – Sands China Ltd. has won two major awards at the M&C Asia Stella Awards 2026, with Sands Resorts Macao retaining its Best Integrated Resort (MICE) title and The Venetian Macao clinching the Best Meetings Hotel (Macao). The accolades recognise Sands China’s dedication to delivering exceptional MICE experiences.

articles.title: Wynn Launches 20th Anniversary Share Award for Team Members
articles.summary: Macao, September 3, 2026 – As this year marks the company's 20th anniversary in Macao, Wynn Macau, Limited announced a one-time "Wynn Macau 20th Anniversary Share Award", under which eligible team members of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace will be granted shares in Wynn Macau, Limited.
